questions.question: Before leaving Babylon for Jerusalem, Ezra searched the camp by the Ahava canal. Which group of people did he find missing?
Ezra asked God for a safe journey for the returning exiles, without a soldier escort. God granted his request. True or false?
Before leaving for Jerusalem, Ezra weighed out treasure to the priests and Levites for God's house. What was it?

answers.text: Silver and gold and sacred articles
Spears and shields for the road
Grain and oil for the altar

questions.question: When Ezra's group delivered King Artaxerxes' edicts to the governors west of the Euphrates, what did the governors do?

answers.text: Helped the people and the house of God
Demanded tribute from the priests and Levites
Sent Ezra and his group back to Babylon
